# dsh-awesome-agent-preset
English | 中文
Ultra-lean daily coding agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`).
## Highlights
- **Lean & Responsive**: Removes heavy orchestration layers (no file delivery tool (`present`), goal
s, complex plan modes, sub-agents, or TODO trackers). Focuses purely on fast, direct coding cycles.

- **Essential Tooling**: Retains core tools needed for day-to-day software development:
- File readi

ng, editing, and fast directory scanning (`fs`, `fs-search`)
- Full-featured Bash execution (`tool-b

ash`)
- Background asynchronous task management (`tool-jobs`)
- External skill packs support (`skill

-filesystem`, `tool-skill`)
- On-demand context compaction & memory protection (`compaction`, `/comp

act`)
- **Tuned FS & Search Efficiency (Aligned with AGENTS.md)**:
- `tool-fs-search`: caps `glob` r
esults to ≤ 50 entries and `grep` matches to ≤ 50 (preview ≤ 500 bytes/line), preventing context flo

oding and utilizing spill files when exceeded.
- `tool-fs`: `readLimit: 800` (max 600 chars/line, ma
x 120KB), ensuring cohesive code units are read in full while preventing massive monolithic files fr

om blowing up token windows.
- **Resilient Bash & Long-running Job Execution**:
- `tool-bash`: enabl
es background job support and `promoteOnTimeout: true` (smoothly promotes timed-out foreground comma

nds into background jobs, preventing task termination and UI hangs).
- Built-in `bash-sandbox` execu
tor tuning & Windows adaptation (enables Bash sandbox, disables conflicting `pwsh-sandbox`, and conf
igures 120s/600s resilient timeouts with 3s termination grace) out of the box, delegating stream out

put cap to global configuration or official 64KB defaults.
- **Master Persona with Operation Boundar
y Partitioning**: Instructs the model as a master autonomous engineer, biasing toward direct concurr
ent action for coding tasks while strictly isolating irreversible operations (npm publish: strictly
conservative, never mutate versions, and immune to transient registry validation lag/404s without re
trying in-flight publishes), ensuring both blistering local speed and rock-solid deployment safety.

1. Restart or launch DeepSeek Harness (`dsh web`).
2. In the preset dropdown list above the prompt i

nput bar, select **`awesome-agent`**.
3. Start coding!
